---
name: Bug or new Mac
about: Something went wrong, or a report from a Mac FanPilot hasn't been tested on
---

**Mac:** model (`sysctl -n hw.model`), chip, macOS version

**What happened, and what you expected:**

**Output** (no root needed, nothing is changed):

```
/Applications/FanPilot.app/Contents/MacOS/fanpilotctl status
/Applications/FanPilot.app/Contents/MacOS/fanpilotctl keys F
/Applications/FanPilot.app/Contents/MacOS/fanpilotctl helper
```

**Helper log**, if the helper misbehaved: `tail -100 /Library/Logs/FanPilot-helper.log`
